points.quote: the use of material produced by generative artificial intelligence (GAI) without the specific permission of the tutor/lecturer
points.gist: Using material produced by generative AI without the specific permission of the tutor or lecturer may constitute plagiarism.

points.quote: where permission to use GAI has been granted, the use of material produced by GAI must be referenced or acknowledged
points.gist: Where permission to use GAI has been granted, material it produces must be referenced or acknowledged.

points.quote: the use of material produced by paraphrasing tools
points.gist: Use of material produced by paraphrasing tools is listed among things that may constitute plagiarism.
